commit.message:
Implement PEP-789 comprehension unpacking.
Rewrite set/dict comprehension parsing to simplify their node structure.

Add tests for comprehension unpacking, contributed by Morax.

Co-authored-by: Morax <james20081204@gmail.com>
Avoid additional error check in safely typed cases.
Use a slightly faster type check in __Pyx_PySet_Update().

Clean up some older code.
Remove a hack that was only needed for a CPython alpha version.

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
